items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: And under the direction of Valmo Victor, you probably heard of him.

ctx.x: Uh huh. And uh, did you ever hear Toots Johnson's band?

Not that I can recall. He was from Baton Rouge. I thought maybe he'd hired him. Probably there's a possibility, yeah. But like I said, I was, you know, relatively small because I came to New Orleans, uh, when I was about five, six years old. And then my daddy moved to Chicago and I went to Chicago and live a while. And I came back to New Orleans when I was around eleven. And then I started to, uh, go into grade school. Here over at Tom Lafon, that's when I started my musical career. Well, we first Negro school…
I haven't, I remember the name, but I can't place it. I'm trying to think of who I would ever know.
